item.title: Washington bill would require universities to provide abortion pills
item.description: Washington state lawmakers are considering legislation to require that public colleges and universities offer abortion pills on campus and provide referrals if they lack health centers.

item.title: ‘Trans’ scholar begins dissertation with ‘Hello, darling,’ then tells publisher to remove it
item.description: Anilenia Hernández's dissertation, “A Brief History of My Gendered Body,” was removed from ProQuest at the author's request after facing backlash online.

item.title: Students flock to Catholicism as faith thrives: Inside SEEK 2026
item.description: ANALYSIS/OPINION The College Fix’s Gabrielle Temaat went to the 2026 SEEK conference to witness one of the biggest gatherings of Catholic and Christian students since Charlie Kirk’s assassination. She asked students what it’s like to live out their Catholic faith on secular college campuses.

item.title: Michigan State U. to pay $300K to professor called ‘racist’ by trustees

item.title: 95% of faculty worry students will rely on AI, diminish critical thinking skills: survey
item.description: Ninety-five percent of faculty are concerned that students will become overly reliant on generative artificial intelligence tools like ChatGPT, according to a new survey released Wednesday. The American Association of Colleges and Universities and Elon University surveyed 1,057 faculty members at U.S. institutions.
